Callout.Name: Wrong-Way Driver
Callout.Message: Vehicle driving the wrong way on a dual carriageway.

Script.Line: It is coming straight at people with its headlights on.
Three callers now and every one of them saying the same thing.
Somebody is going to be killed. Somebody needs to shut that road.

Lines.Approach: Several callers, all saying the same: wrong side of the barrier, headlights on.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
